title: I looped a clip with -stream_loop. Is it seamless?
fullTitle: FFmpeg -stream_loop Follows the Audio: 355 or 359 Frames

scenes.narration: You loop a four second clip with dash stream loop two. Three plays: twelve seconds, no seam? We mark every frame and every audio sample, and read the result on two builds, ffmpeg six point one point one and eight point one point two.

The picture is one hundred twenty marked frames. The audio is a ramp where every sample says where it came from. Control: with both four seconds long, the loop is exactly three hundred sixty frames, twelve seconds, on both builds. Readers: f f probe packets, and a decode.
captions: Equal lengths: 360 frames, 12.0 s, both builds.
Same as the concat demuxer control.

scenes.narration: Now the audio is three point nine seconds, a hundred milliseconds short. Re-encoded, the loop falls short of twelve seconds on both builds, by different amounts. Six point one point one keeps three hundred fifty five frames. Eight point one point two keeps three hundred fifty nine. Same command, two builds. The loop follows the audio.

With the audio four point one seconds, the loop is twelve point three seconds on both builds, and the picture freezes a hundred thirty milliseconds at each seam. With dash c copy and the short audio, the picture keeps all three hundred sixty frames, but the sound has a hundred millisecond hole at each seam.
captions: Audio 4.1 s: 12.3 s, picture holes 0.13 s.
-c copy, audio 3.9 s: 0.1 s sound holes.

scenes.narration: With an infinite loop and dash t twenty five, the length is exact on both builds: twenty five seconds, seven hundred fifty frames. With the short audio each later play starts late: at frame two, then three on six point one point one, and at frame zero, then one on eight point one point two. No drift.
captions: Short audio: plays start late, by build.

scenes.narration: Before you loop, compare the audio length and the picture length. When they match, the loop is exact on both builds. When they differ, the loss depends on the build. Not tested: other builds, containers and codecs, real footage with encoder delay, stream order, players.
captions: Match audio and picture lengths first.
Not tested: other builds, real footage.
